description: This file defines a feature class for listing comments associated with a specific article identified by its slug. It includes a query object, a handler for processing the request, and code to retrieve the article with its comments and author from the database, handling the case where the article is not found.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Contains the Query record and the QueryHandler class for handling listing comments for an article.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query to retrieve an article by slug, including its comments and authors, and returns the comments wrapped in a CommentsEnvelope. Throws a RestException if the article is not found.
